Container.Name: Sure-Worker
Container.Overview:
Background worker (Sidekiq) for Sure, the self-hosted personal finance app. Install the main "Sure" template first.
The worker runs bank syncs, CSV/PDF imports, daily market data, AI jobs and sends all emails (password resets, rule notifications). Without it, imports and syncs never complete.
Use the SAME image tag, Secret Key Base, Active Record Encryption keys (Primary Key, Deterministic Key, Key Derivation Salt - if you set them), database settings, Redis URL and Storage path as the Sure container. Start it after Sure has finished its first boot (database migrations).
This container is on the "sure-net" Docker network with postgres17_sure, redis_sure and Sure. Database Host and Redis URL are already set for them. Install order: postgres17_sure, redis_sure, Sure, Sure-Worker.
Full step-by-step guide: https://github.com/Yusseiin/unraid-templates/blob/main/docs/sure-setup.md
SMTP settings only need to be set here: email is sent by the worker, not the web container. SMTP TLS Enabled must be exactly "true" for SMTPS (port 465); use "false" for STARTTLS on port 587.
Container.Requires: The Docker network "sure-net", postgres17_sure, redis_sure and Sure.

Config.Name: Storage
Config.Description: Must be the same path used by the Sure container.

Config.Name: Secret Key Base
Config.Description: Required. Must be identical to the value in the Sure container.

Config.Name: Encryption Primary Key
Config.Description: MUST be identical to the value in the Sure container. Set all three or none (leave blank only if blank there too).

Config.Name: Encryption Deterministic Key
Config.Description: MUST be identical to the value in the Sure container. Set all three or none (leave blank only if blank there too).

Config.Name: Encryption Key Derivation Salt
Config.Description: MUST be identical to the value in the Sure container. Set all three or none (leave blank only if blank there too).

Config.Name: Database Host
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container.

Config.Name: Database Port
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container.

Config.Name: Database Name
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container.

Config.Name: Database User
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container.

Config.Name: Database Password
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container.

Config.Name: Redis URL
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container.

Config.Name: App Domain
Config.Description: Host name Sure is reached at (e.g. sure.example.com). Used to build links in emails.

Config.Name: Self Hosted
Config.Description: Enables self-hosting features. Leave true.

Config.Name: Assume SSL
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container.

Config.Name: Force SSL
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container.

Config.Name: Email Sender
Config.Description: Address emails are sent from (e.g. sure@example.com). Must be allowed by your SMTP server.

Config.Name: SMTP Address
Config.Description: SMTP server host name (e.g. smtp.example.com). Leave blank to disable email.

Config.Name: SMTP Port
Config.Description: 465 for SMTPS (TLS Enabled = true) or 587 for STARTTLS (TLS Enabled = false).

Config.Name: SMTP Username
Config.Description: SMTP login user name.

Config.Name: SMTP Password
Config.Description: SMTP login password.

Config.Name: SMTP TLS Enabled
Config.Description: Exactly 'true' = TLS from the start (SMTPS, port 465). Anything else = STARTTLS when offered (port 587).

Config.Name: SMTP TLS Skip Verify
Config.Description: Exactly 'true' disables SMTP certificate verification. Last resort only.

Config.Name: Exchange Rate Provider
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container.

Config.Name: Securities Provider
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container.

Config.Name: Twelve Data API Key
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container.

Config.Name: Market Data Sync Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone for the daily price import (e.g. Europe/Rome). Unknown names fall back to UTC. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker. Values saved in Settings > Self-Hosting take precedence.

Config.Name: Market Data Sync Time
Config.Description: HH:MM (24h, in the Market Data Sync Timezone) for the daily price import, Monday to Friday. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: Market Data Sync Enabled
Config.Description: 1 = import security prices daily (Monday to Friday), 0 = off. Do not leave blank (blank means off). Values saved in Settings > Self-Hosting take precedence. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: Assistant Type
Config.Description: Forces the AI assistant type for the whole instance. Blank = each family chooses in Settings > Self-Hosting. builtin = in-app chat using the OpenAI fields. external = your own agent (also needs EXTERNAL_ASSISTANT_URL / EXTERNAL_ASSISTANT_TOKEN). mcp_only = no in-app chat at all (sidebar, toggle and mobile tab hidden), MCP stays available for your own agent; background categorization keeps working. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: OpenAI Access Token
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container (AI jobs run in the worker).

Config.Name: OpenAI Model
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container.

Config.Name: OpenAI URI Base
Config.Description: Same as the Sure container.

Config.Name: External Assistant URL
Config.Description: Only for Assistant Type external: your agent's OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint, e.g. https://your-agent/v1/chat/completions. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: External Assistant Token
Config.Description: Only for Assistant Type external: API token for your agent. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: External Assistant Model
Config.Description: Only for Assistant Type external: model name. Blank = openclaw/main. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: LLM Provider
Config.Description: AI provider for chat and background AI jobs: openai (OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible API such as Ollama) or anthropic (native Anthropic API, needs Anthropic API Key). Setting it here locks the choice on the Settings page. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Only for LLM Provider anthropic. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: Anthropic Model
Config.Description: Only for LLM Provider anthropic. Blank = Sure's default Claude model. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: LLM Context Window
Config.Description: Token budget for OpenAI-compatible models. Blank = Settings page value or 2048. Raise it for larger local models (e.g. 8192). Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: OpenAI Request Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds per LLM request. Blank = Settings page value or 60. Raise for slow local models (e.g. 300 for Ollama on CPU). Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: AI Response Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds the chat waits for a full answer before showing no response. Blank = Settings page value or 90 (minimum 30). Raise for slow local models. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: Vector Store Provider
Config.Description: AI document search. Blank = hosted OpenAI when an OpenAI token is set. pgvector = store embeddings in postgres17_sure (needs an embeddings endpoint below). Best set before the first start of Sure, as its table is created by a database migration. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: Embedding URI Base
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint for pgvector, e.g. http://ollama:11434/v1. Blank = OpenAI URI Base, then OpenAI. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: Embedding Model
Config.Description: Embedding model name. Do not leave blank. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: Embedding Dimensions
Config.Description: Must match the embedding model (1024 for mxbai-embed-large). Do not leave blank or change after pgvector data exists. Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: Brandfetch Client ID
Config.Description: Optional. Client ID from brandfetch.com for bank and merchant logos. Set it here rather than on the Settings page (a blank value here can clear a key saved there). Use the same value in Sure and Sure-Worker.
